takeaways: Forrester's risk-adjusted composite model shows Microsoft 365 Copilot returns through reclaimed hours, higher sales win rates and faster onboarding, but the figures are averages, not guarantees.
Total cost includes far more than licenses: implementation, IT staff and especially training drive the budget, while phased, role-based rollouts and good data governance speed up payback.
Measure your own baseline for one repetitive task per role for two weeks, then use Copilot consistently on it and compare the hours to build a local ROI case.
hook: Leaders keep asking whether Microsoft 365 Copilot is worth the license cost. This episode is for decision makers and adoption leads who need a realistic ROI picture. It walks through Forrester's Total Economic Impact model across sales, operations, people and payback, and shows how to test the numbers in your own organization.
